exampleTr: Satıcının yapmacık övgü dolu tavrı bizi rahatsız etti.

clue: To experience a process or change.
example: The building will undergo repairs.

clue: Without a paid job.
example: He is currently unemployed.

clue: Not treating people equally or reasonably.
example: That decision was unfair.

clue: Except if something happens.
tr: Belirli bir koşul gerçekleşmezse anlamı veren bağlaç.
example: We will go unless it rains.

clue: To make information more current.
tr: Yeni bilgileri ekleyerek güncel hâle getirmek.
example: Please update your contact details.

clue: To consume all of a supply.
example: Do not use up all the paper.

clue: Showing a lack of intelligence or meaningful thought.
example: The speech was full of vacuous promises.

clue: Several different types of something.
example: We need more variety.

clue: A machine used to transport people or things.
tr: İnsan veya eşya taşımak için kullanılan araç.
example: No vehicle can enter this street.

clue: Capable of working successfully.
example: We need a viable alternative.

clue: To speak about someone in a very abusive way.
tr: Birini ağır ve kötüleyici sözlerle hedef almak.
example: Critics tried to vilify the author.

clue: A four-string musical instrument played with a bow.
tr: Yayla çalınan dört telli müzik aleti.
example: He plays the violin every day.

clue: Filled with bitter criticism.
example: She received a vitriolic letter.
exampleTr: Ağır hakaretlerle dolu bir mektup aldı.

clue: Someone who works without being paid.
tr: Karşılık beklemeden yardım etmeyi teklif eden kişi.
example: She works as a volunteer at the shelter.

clue: To stop sleeping.
example: I wake up before my alarm.

clue: To gradually decrease in strength, size or intensity.
tr: Güç veya yoğunluk bakımından giderek azalmak.
example: Public interest began to wane.

clue: To prepare the body for exercise.
example: Always warm up before running.

clue: To wash dishes after a meal.
example: I will wash up after dinner.

clue: A clear liquid people need to drink.
example: Please drink some water.

clue: To become unusable from repeated use.
example: Cheap shoes wear out quickly.

clue: To remove unwanted elements from a group.
tr: Bir grup içindeki istenmeyen öğeleri ayıklamak.
example: The test helps weed out duplicate entries.
exampleTr: Test yinelenen kayıtları ayıklamaya yardımcı olur.

clue: Used to contrast two different facts.
tr: İki durumu karşılaştırırken zıtlık bildiren bağlaç.
example: I like tea, whereas she prefers coffee.
exampleTr: Ben çayı severim, o ise kahveyi tercih eder.

clue: To gradually reduce a large number.
tr: Büyük bir sayıyı aşamalı olarak azaltmak.
example: We need to whittle down the shortlist.

clue: The woman someone is married to.
example: His wife works nearby.

clue: An opening in a wall, usually covered with glass.
tr: Duvarda bulunan, genellikle camla kaplı açıklık.
example: Open the window for fresh air.

clue: To resist damage or pressure.
example: The bridge can withstand strong winds.

clue: To ask yourself about something.
tr: Bir şeyi kendi kendine merak etmek.
example: I wonder what happened.

clue: Worth the time or effort spent on it.
example: Learning a language is worthwhile.

clue: To record something on paper.
example: Write down the new words.

clue: A strong and persistent feeling of longing.
example: She felt a yearning for home.
exampleTr: Eve karşı derin bir özlem duydu.

clue: The past, especially a time remembered with nostalgia.
example: The film recalls the fashions of yesteryear.

clue: Having lived for only a short time.
tr: Henüz az yaşamış, yaşı küçük olan.
example: The young bird cannot fly yet.

clue: An African animal with black-and-white stripes.
tr: Siyah beyaz çizgileri olan Afrika hayvanı.
example: The zebra stood beside a tree.

clue: A line or movement with repeated sharp turns left and right.
tr: Art arda sağa ve sola keskin dönüşler yapan çizgi veya hareket.
example: The path follows a zigzag up the hill.
